positions.name: Bremer Apartment Building/Night Shift Super Assistant
positions.description: Supports the aging super during evening hours: responding to leak reports, managing package logins, calming disputes over noise/music, and knowing which floor has spare keys.

positions.name: Brooklyn Music Conservatory Extension/Community Ensemble Coordinator
positions.description: Organizes the monthly 'Bremer Basement Jam' — booking local musicians, scheduling sound checks, securing permits for acoustic sets, and managing rotating open-mic sign-ups.

positions.name: Café Sonrisa (Bilingual After-School Program)/Mentor-Tutor
positions.description: Provides homework help and cultural mentorship to immigrant teens after school — often meeting them at the Corner Coffee Shop or in Bremer’s common lounge.

positions.name: Corner Coffee Shop/Barista
positions.description: Prepares espresso drinks, manages register, and fosters the shop’s warm, communal atmosphere — often remembering regulars’ orders and listening to their stories.

positions.name: Greenwich Village Community Garden Co-op/Steward
positions.description: Manages shared plots on the rooftop-accessible garden terrace (adjacent to Bremer’s fire escape); coordinates seasonal planting, composting, and neighbor-led workshops.

positions.name: NYU Tisch School of the Arts/Undergraduate Acting Student
positions.organization: NYU Tisch School of the Arts
positions.description: Immersed in conservatory-style training: scene study, voice, movement, and collaborative creation; balances auditions, rehearsals, and late-night script analysis in Bremer’s thin-walled apartments.

positions.name: New York Public Library – Greenwich Branch/Digital Literacy Volunteer Trainer
positions.organization: New York Public Library – Greenwich Branch
positions.description: Leads weekly workshops helping elderly tenants and new immigrants navigate online services — library portals, rent stabilization forms, telehealth platforms, and video-calling with faraway family.

positions.name: Rooftop Water Tower Restoration Project/Historic Preservation Apprentice
positions.description: Assists licensed preservationists in documenting and maintaining the landmark 1920s water tower; learns masonry repair, archival photo logging, and NYC Landmarks Commission protocols.

positions.name: Self-employed (contributes to The Atlantic, New York Magazine, various outlets)/Freelance journalist and novelist
positions.organization: Self-employed (contributes to The Atlantic, New York Magazine, various outlets)
positions.description: Freelance writer earning income from magazine features, copywriting for a tech firm, and occasional journalism workshops he teaches at The New School.

positions.name: The Atlantic / New York Magazine Freelance Network/Editorial Research Fellow
positions.organization: The Atlantic / New York Magazine Freelance Network
positions.description: Contracts with Aaron Whitfield and other freelancers to fact-check narratives, source archival material, verify immigrant community references, and cross-reference neighborhood history for long-form pieces.

positions.name: The Bremer Tenant Association/Building Archivist
positions.description: Documents oral histories, repairs the aging lobby bulletin board archive, digitizes tenant-submitted photos/stories, and curates the annual 'Bremer Memory Wall' installation.
